bookSourceGroup: 综合小说·公开免费章节
bookSourceComment: 酷匠官网公开免费章节。PC搜索配合官方手机详情及阅读页；目录在首个VIP分卷之前截止，并排除单章VIP标记。付费或登录页不提供正文，未处理加密、验证码或登录限制。搜索当前支持公开第一页。

ruleToc.chapterList: @js: var b=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://www[.]kujiang[.]com/book/([0-9]+)/catalog')); var out=[]; var allowed={}; var ds=java.getElements('.kjsection-catalog dl'); for(var i=0;i<ds.size();i++){var d=ds.get(i); var dt=d.select('dt').text(); if(/VIP/i.test(String(dt))) break; var as=d.select('dd a[href]'); for(var j=0;j<as.size();j++){var a=as.get(j); var m=String(a.attr('href')).match(new RegExp('^/book/([0-9]+)/([0-9]+)$')); if(b && m && m[1]===b[1] && !a.hasClass('vip')){out.push(a);allowed[m[2]]=true;}}} book.putVariable('readerKujiangFreeChapters',JSON.stringify({bookId:b?b[1]:'',chapters:allowed})); out;

ruleContent.content: @js: var safe=false; try{var g=JSON.parse(String(book.getVariable('readerKujiangFreeChapters')||'{}')); var m=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://m[.]kujiang[.]com/book/([0-9]+)/([0-9]+)$')); safe=!!(m && g.bookId===m[1] && g.chapters && g.chapters[m[2]]===true);}catch(e){} var es=java.getElements('#readArticle'); if(safe && es.size()>0){var c=es.get(0).clone(); c.select('script,style,iframe').remove(); c.html();}else{'';}
